ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the fluke surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) circular clusters providing high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distributed mapping of small, high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) scattered across the medial and distal sections of both lobes on a uniform dark ground.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression at the center-point with a wide pixel angle and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude pixel variations (jagged peaks and valleys) at the distal tips; moderate, irregular serration along the length of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep on the interior margins transitioning to highly irregular, non-linear terminal boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of roughly circular white-on-black pixel rings (diameters ranging from approx. 5 to 15 pixels) across the central and lateral fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the entire visible ventral surface and significant structural erosion/fragmentation of the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'tattered' or heavily-eroded fringe appearance of the fluke lobe extremities.
